text: Risk management is the process of dealing with possible problems before they happen. First, it is important to identify risks, which means finding out what could go wrong in a project. After that, you need mitigation strategies to reduce the chance or impact of these risks. For example, you might train staff or buy insurance. It is also wise to create contingency plans, so you know what to do if a risk actually occurs. Finally, monitoring means checking risks regularly and updating your plans when things change. By following these steps, you can protect your project and make better decisions.
